questions.prompt: Can a Figma plugin run in the background while nobody uses it?

options.explanation: Publishing does not change this rule.

options.text: No, a person must start it
options.explanation: Right. Figma says it's not possible to build plugins that run in the background.
Dev Mode plugins are read-only. No page says they run in the background.

questions.prompt: Canva unified three products in the Canva Developers SDK. Which three?

options.text: Apps SDK, Connect APIs and MCP
options.explanation: Right. They are now three surfaces of one SDK.
Those are the names of Figma's APIs.

options.text: Data Connector, Design Editor and URL Expander
options.explanation: Those are three of Canva's intents, not products.

questions.prompt: What does Figma's REST API mostly allow?

options.text: Editing any layer in any file
options.explanation: Figma says the REST API is largely read-only.

options.text: Reading files, with a few writes
options.explanation: Right. Comments, variables and dev resources are the write exceptions.
The REST API reads files from your own script, tool or app.
